summary: Play complete solo or pass-and-play backgammon on one Kobo.
release_notes: Dice come from the operating system rather than from a counter, the board says whose move it is and marks where a checker may go, and every roll is written down.
user: Somebody who wants a real board game on their Kobo, alone or with a friend.
job: Play complete backgammon, solo against the device or pass-and-play, with every turn written down.
offline: The whole game runs on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader

non_goals: It does not play against a remote opponent over the network.
